from collections import Counter
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r)
    noise={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W)

    # maximal uniform rectangles (holes allowed at noise cells), both dims >=2

    for c in cnt:
        for r1 in range(H):
            for c1 in range(W):
                if I[r1][c1]!=c and (r1,c1) not in noise: continue
                for h in range(2,H-r1+1):
                    for w in range(2,W-c1+1):
                        cells=[(a,b) for a in range(r1,r1+h) for b in range(c1,c1+w)]
                        if all(I[a][b]==c or (a,b) in noise for a,b in cells):
                            # maximality

                            lf = c1>0 and all(I[a][c1-1]==c or (a,c1-1) in noise for a in range(r1,r1+h))
                            rt = c1+w<W and all(I[a][c1+w]==c or (a,c1+w) in noise for a in range(r1,r1+h))
                            if not(up or dn or lf or rt):

    # dedupe

    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    for i,j in noise:

            inside.sort(key=lambda x:x[1]); out[i][j]=inside[0][0]

    return out,noise,rects
